# Ardent Studio

> Ardent Studio is an AI consulting and automation studio in Boynton Beach, Florida. It serves small businesses across Palm Beach County and works with teams remotely. It helps a business find where AI actually helps, builds the tool at a fixed scope and price, and trains the team to run it.

Founder: Ashley Somogyi
Location: Boynton Beach, Florida, United States
Email: hello@ardentstudio.io
Phone: +1 728 201 0192
Free 15-minute call: https://calendly.com/asomogyi-ardentstudio/30min

Prices are fixed and quoted after the free call, before any work starts.

## Services
- [AI setup](https://ardentstudio.io/services/ai-setup): Connect AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT to the systems a business already uses, and show the team what to use them for.
- [AI automation and apps](https://ardentstudio.io/services/ai-automation): Custom AI automation built around how the team already works. Fixed-scope builds.
- [AI chatbot](https://ardentstudio.io/services/ai-chatbot): A website chatbot for 24/7 lead capture and customer questions.
- [Workflow automation](https://ardentstudio.io/services/workflow-automation): Email and workflow automation for small businesses.
- [AI tools setup and training](https://ardentstudio.io/services/ai-tools-setup): Hands-on setup and training on tools such as ChatGPT and Claude.
- [Team training](https://ardentstudio.io/training): Hands-on workshops where the team builds something real. Formats include a 3-hour workshop, a 5-hour half day, and a four-session program.
